source_title: Antofagasta's Centinela strike adds copper supply risk
quote: Copper prices recovered on Wednesday as more than 700 workers began a strike at Antofagasta Plc's (LON: ANTO) Centinela mine in Chile, adding another supply threat in the world's largest copper-producing nation.

source_title: Antofagasta's Centinela strike adds copper supply risk
quote: The striking employees represent 22% of Centinela's direct workforce and the stoppage will restrict operations, the unions said.

source_title: Antofagasta's Centinela strike adds copper supply risk
quote: A key sticking point at Centinela is differences in pay and benefits among employees performing the same jobs but belonging to different unions.

source_title: Antofagasta's Centinela strike adds copper supply risk
quote: Centinela produced 240,400 metric tons of copper last year.

source_title: Antofagasta's Centinela strike adds copper supply risk
quote: Despite the walkout, Antofagasta said it does not expect the disruption to alter its production outlook.

source_title: 1,000조 규모 'K-GX' 닻 올렸다…정부, 철강업에도 GX 정책지원

source_title: 1,000조 규모 'K-GX' 닻 올렸다…정부, 철강업에도 GX 정책지원

source_title: 1,000조 규모 'K-GX' 닻 올렸다…정부, 철강업에도 GX 정책지원
quote: 다만 세제 지원에서는 철강업이 또다시 명단에서 제외됐다.
산업통상부는 10월6일 중동전쟁 대응본부 브리핑에서 원유는 10월 도입물량을 전년평균대비 100%, 11월 물량은 90% 이상 확보하고 있다고 밝혔다.
나프타는 10월 물량을 수요 대비 100% 이상 확보 완료했으며, 11월 물량은 수요 대비 90% 이상을 확보하고자 현재 계약을 진행하고 있다고 전했다.
11월 원유 확보 물량은 8월 중순 대비 20%포인트 정도 늘어난 것이다.

source_title: US forecasts hurricane later this week in Gulf of Mexico
quote: US forecasters said on Tuesday a storm forming in the Gulf of Mexico and speeding towards Louisiana and Mississippi would become the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 within two days.

source_title: US forecasts hurricane later this week in Gulf of Mexico
quote: "The depression is expected to pass to the north of the Yucatan Peninsula on Thursday, and approach the US northern Gulf Coast on Friday," the Hurricane Center said in a statement.

source_title: US forecasts hurricane later this week in Gulf of Mexico
quote: The offshore areas in the Gulf in the storm's path produce 15% of US crude oil and 5% of the country's natural gas.

source_title: US forecasts hurricane later this week in Gulf of Mexico
quote: In the forecast landfall area the storm could affect six refineries operated by Shell, Valero Energy, Marathon, PBF Energy, and Chevron.

source_title: US forecasts hurricane later this week in Gulf of Mexico
quote: Refineries in US Gulf states account for about 50% of the national capacity of 18.2 million barrels per day (bpd).
